answer: Give every agent a work-history ledger that only grows through completed jobs verified by unrelated counterparties, like a reef built coral by coral: one fake identity stays bare rock, while a real agent accumulates a dense, cross-linked record. To forge that record, each new identity must post a time-locked work bond that deepens with every additional identity, like descending a canyon: the first step is cheap, the tenth is a cliff. Sybils can copy a name, but they cannot fake years of interlocking service history.
